title: qa(checklist): platform-core — 19 ledger edits from the 18.2.0 release sweep (#25807)
body:
Filing gate: maintainer-directed task. Filed by the 18.2.0 release-assessment thread · `session_01G3h9iZTpL8aCiXbfsp8H5u`. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not dispatched.

**Maintainer's words** (project thread, 2026-10-25, verbatim): 22:54Z 「约 300 条清单准确性问题：是不是应该开卡？」, then 22:55Z 「写issue，不派发」.

**Parent:** wave anchor #25807 (18.2.0 release test sweep). RUNNER's extraction obligation parks checklist-accuracy findings on the anchor; the maintainer asked for them as issues, so the wave's findings are split into one card per ledger file and the anchor links each card. This is not a release blocker, so it carries no `target:v18`.

**Reader who acts:** the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`). Dedupe (open and closed): no card holds these lines; the 18.0 precedent closed its accuracy rows on its anchor #24579.

## Wanted

For each line below, edit `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`: revise the item's text, bump its `revision`, and append a `history` entry citing the run record the line comes from. Keep `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green. A line that turns out to describe a product defect rather than stale text gets its own card instead of a ledger edit.

## Findings (19)

### From #25812 — `priority:P0`, 23 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956`

- `platform-core.boot-health` c2: deployment-policy unbound flows print as ℹ lines, not ⚠; the clause still describes ⚠.
- `platform-core.nav-surfaces-render`: the console-added "All reports" sidebar destination is outside both meta/app nav and `SURFACES`, so the served-vs-SURFACES diff cannot see it; step 1's `test:smoke` also collects two other specs beside the pin.
- `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render`: marketplace knownGap names "Forbidden", the screen reads "HTTP 502 · fetch failed" (MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED); step 6 names `sys_approval_request/my_pending` for Account Approvals, the served entry is `component/approvals/inbox`; no clause covers a member opening Setup's url-type entries (they render inside the Showcase shell while the server refuses every namespace 403).
- `platform-core.seed-integrity`: the Specimen diff should name the canonical time form ("14:30" → "14:30:00"); step 2's baseline lists 9 of the 19 seeded datasets.
- `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` step 1: production `os serve --preset minimal` is refused earlier ("This stack mounts no auth…"); `os serve --dev --no-server` is the spelling that reaches the SecurityPlugin refusal.

### From #25815 — `release-18.2.0-tier1`, 156 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956` (clause labels: aK = acceptance[K], nK = negative[K])

- `platform-core.activation-ledger-registration-home` a4: packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.test.ts ('registers exactly the objects each package declares') ties PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE to the declaring sources and would pin the one-owner membership, but is not in the ref
- `platform-core.activation-ledger-registration-home` n2: platform-objects/src/plugin.test.ts asserts exactly one registering manifest; no pin drives a second registrant to observe the 'already owned by package' boot failure
- `platform-core.activation-ledger-row-contract` n5/a4 (door half): packages/qa/dogfood/test/catalog-activation-door.dogfood.test.ts › 'a type with no switch is refused 400 by the door itself' and packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation-door.test.ts (audience anchors 400, nothing written) exist and are not in this item's ref
- `platform-core.activation-ledger-row-contract` a2: the dogfood key-set reading proves the physical table lacks organization_id but not the step-7 refused INSERT / control INSERT pair the verify names
- `platform-core.activation-ledger-row-contract` a3: pins assert update-not-delete for the action (HTTP) and flow (store) kinds only; position/permission/sharing_rule re-enable rows are not covered here
- `platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep` ref is accurate on scope (a2 pinned half, a3, n0-n1; a0/a1/a4 live; a5 a source read)
- `platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep` a3: live sweep-line corroboration of the reaped count stays the run's
- `platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep` n0: the unit proves the onlyWhen predicate reaches the reap filter/candidate read on a recording fake engine, not that real paused/running rows survive
- `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip` ref is accurate: package-first-authoring.dogfood.test.ts and studio-object-designer.spec.ts are declared as scoring no clause; studio-record-page.spec.ts scores a2 only
- `platform-core.metadata-registry-serving` a0: the pin never checks the registered kinds against DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY (step 2's presence table); it asserts only dashboard/action/report entries
- `platform-core.nav-surfaces-render` a0/n0/n1/n3 score only if the parent can run `pnpm -C examples/app-showcase test:smoke` (Playwright + a live showcase with a console); otherwise not-run (browser)
- `platform-core.nav-surfaces-render` a1: nothing in the ref computes the served-nav vs SURFACES diff — the 'coverage is current' clause has no automation
- `platform-core.serve-composition-v18` run note: serve-organization-record-page.e2e.test.ts is a *.e2e.test.ts file — it collects only under OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly; a run without it reports 0 tests for that file (a2 then not scored)
- `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` a3: scored from the pin by the clause's own fallback ('with no such boot run, this clause rests on authz-identity-objects-boot-refusal.test.ts — record which'); the run record must say the live steps[1] boot was not run.

## Acceptance

- Every line above is either applied (item revised, `revision` bumped, `history` cites the record) or answered on this card with the reason it was not.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green.
- The PR links this card and #25807.
